purpose: Load monthly metro unemployment panel and CES payroll covariate into matrices.
outputs: in-memory dict with Y, payroll, months, metros, ces, mean_level
hidden_transformations: deduplicate by last row; keep units with total missing <= MAX_GAP; linear interpolation/backfill/forward-fill; month-of-year deseasonalization; winsorize and standardize payroll
defaults_or_tuning: start=2000-01; end=2026-12; deseasonalize=True; require_cov=True; MAX_GAP=6; cov_col=payroll_growth_12m

purpose: Run unemployment empirical specs A-D and write JSON summaries.
outputs: outputs/empirical/unemp_A.json; unemp_B.json; unemp_C.json; unemp_D.json; unemp_abc.json (absent in current tree)
hidden_transformations: delegates to load_unemp_panel and load_cbsa_covariates; matched_cov restricts to complete population/GDP covariates
defaults_or_tuning: SEED=13; ranks (1,0,1) no cov; (1,0,1,1,1) cov; q=1; J_min=10; ridge=0.5; n_restarts=2; n_sweeps=60; riesz_ridge=1e-4; kappa_c=0.03; xs_kernel=cluster
overwrite_or_atomicity_risk: direct json.dump to final paths; no atomic write or resume guard

purpose: Shared empirical AR(2) construction, targets, estimation wrapper, diagnostics, rank/covariate robustness.
key_functions: build_ar2; ar2_targets; run_ar2; rank_robustness; covariate_robustness; rank_selection_table
outputs: dict with estimates, standard errors, derived diagnostics, rank/covariate robustness
hidden_transformations: always uses Ymat[2:] effective sample; includes lag1 and lag2 blocks; covariates enter one month lagged; targets include lag2 even when rank is zero
test_coverage: covered only indirectly by generic tests if present

purpose: Load metro covariates by Zillow names or CBSA codes.

purpose: Compute geographic spatial-kernel standard errors for empirical housing and unemployment outputs.
